feature: Direct/indirect equivalence for axial shading dictionary fields and nested scalar values
source_location: Primary ISO 32000-2 EC3: §7.3.10 printed p.34, physical PDF p.49 (paragraph: except where documented to the contrary, object values may be direct or indirect with equivalent semantics); Table 77 physical pp.245–246 (printed pp.230–231); Table 79 physical p.249 (printed p.234). Table 79 defines /Coords as four numbers, /Domain as two numbers defaulting to [0,1], and /Extend as two booleans defaulting false. Table 77 /BBox is an optional target-space clipping boundary.
errata: No EC3 annotation affecting the cited axial/table entries was found on physical pp.245–249. The general §7.3.10 rule itself is effective text; no relevant exception in these table entries was located.
test_assertions: Existing tests assert gradient endpoints, no-extend behavior and BBox clipping with direct arrays/scalars. They do not distinguish direct values from indirect references, nor test indirect array members.
verdict: Code-path support is present: all four readers resolve each referenced member. Assertion coverage is missing for nested indirect representations; no failure is established.
residuals: Type 2/3 only. Public CPU pixels check nondefault Domain, nested array/scalar references, BBox clipping, and both true/false polarities for each Extend position. No mesh byte-field or all-shading conformance claim.
execution: Tracked indirect_shading_values_spec_audit: both tests pass in shading-wave62b.log. Model all-targets Clippy passes.

feature: Direct/indirect equivalence for radial shading dictionary fields and nested scalar values
source_location: Primary ISO 32000-2 EC3: Table 80 physical pp.251–252 (printed pp.236–237); Table 77 physical pp.245–246 (printed pp.230–231); general direct/indirect equivalence at §7.3.10 physical p.49 (printed p.34). Table 80 defines six /Coords numbers, optional two-number /Domain default [0,1], and optional two-boolean /Extend default [false,false]; Table 77 /BBox is an optional target-space clip.
errata: No EC3 annotation affecting the cited radial/table entries was found on physical pp.245–252. No directness exception for these array values was located.
test_assertions: Existing tests exercise radial interpolation and BBox with direct values; they do not exercise indirect references or indirect array elements.
verdict: Code-path support is present; direct-versus-indirect assertion coverage is absent. No implementation failure is established.
residuals: Type 2/3 only. Public CPU pixels check nondefault Domain, nested array/scalar references, BBox clipping, and both true/false polarities for each Extend position. No mesh byte-field or all-shading conformance claim.
execution: Tracked indirect_shading_values_spec_audit: both tests pass in shading-wave62b.log. Model all-targets Clippy passes.
